articles.title: Alt-right troll Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported
articles.description: Alt-right troll Milo Yiannopoulos was arrested by ICE on Thursday, and today the Department of Homeland Security confirmed to Reuters and the Washington Post that he had been deported to the UK.
